endorsements.name: Business Auto Coverage Form
endorsements.notes: Standard ISO Business Auto Coverage Form. Defines covered auto symbols 1-9 and 19, Liability Coverage (Section II), Physical Damage Coverage (Section III), Conditions (Section IV), Definitions (Section V). 'Insured contract' definition (§V.H) includes assumed tort liability — supports contractual liability for indemnity assumed in MSAs. Other Insurance clause (§IV.B.5) — primary for owned autos, excess for non-owned, but primary for liability assumed under an 'insured contract'.

endorsements.name: Common Policy Conditions
endorsements.notes: Standard policy conditions. Cancellation: 10 days nonpayment, 30 days other reasons (overridden to 60 days by 461-0155 Broadening Endorsement Item 1 for Auto).

endorsements.name: Arizona Changes
endorsements.notes: AZ state-specific amendments. Replaces Concealment, Misrepresentation or Fraud condition. Coverage denied only where misrepresentation is fraudulent, material, AND we would not have issued or would have issued differently.

endorsements.name: Nuclear Energy Liability Exclusion (Broad Form)
endorsements.notes: Standard nuclear exclusion.

endorsements.name: Exclusion of Terrorism Involving Nuclear, Biological or Chemical Terrorism
endorsements.notes: Excludes NBC terrorism only — does NOT exclude conventional terrorism.

endorsements.name: Notice to Policyholder on Terrorism
endorsements.notes: TRIA disclosure notice — federal TRIA does not apply to commercial auto.

endorsements.name: Arizona Changes - Nonrenewal
endorsements.notes: 30 days written notice required for nonrenewal. Notice not required if insured requested nonrenewal, policy expressly nonrenewable, premium unpaid, renewal offered, insured insured elsewhere, or insured requested termination.

endorsements.name: Auto Medical Payments Coverage
endorsements.notes: Med Pay endorsement, $5,000 limit. Medical and funeral expenses for insured occupying covered auto or struck as pedestrian.

endorsements.name: Arizona Uninsured Motorists Coverage
endorsements.notes: AZ UM coverage at $1M. 3-year time limitation for written notice of intent to pursue UM claim. Arbitration available by mutual agreement (coverage disputes excluded).

endorsements.name: Arizona UM/UIM Coverage Offer and Selection/Rejection
endorsements.notes: AZ-mandated UM/UIM offer form. Insured may purchase UM/UIM from $50,000 single limit up to BI liability limit, or reject. Selection initials/signature appear blank/redacted in available chunks — confirm actual elections.

endorsements.name: Arizona Underinsured Motorists Coverage
endorsements.notes: AZ-specific UIM endorsement. Defines 'underinsured motor vehicle,' adds Who Is An Insured, sets exclusions, provides limit reduction by amounts available under tortfeasor's BI policies, 3-year time limitation, arbitration clause. UIM limit per Schedule ($1M).

endorsements.name: Designated Insured
endorsements.notes: Schedule-based AI endorsement. Adds Desert Trailer Systems Inc as Designated Insured for Liability Coverage only. NOT a blanket AI — no AI status for Maricopa County or Run-Test's other contract counterparties under this form (rely on 461-0478 for blanket AI).

endorsements.name: Notice of Cancellation to Designated Entity(s)
endorsements.notes: Multi-schedule designated entity NOC endorsement. 30-day written notice (other than non-payment). Schedules across pages 44, 45, 46. Notice does NOT grant or extend rights — informational only.

endorsements.name: Business Auto Coverage Broadening Endorsement
endorsements.notes: Hanover proprietary multi-feature broadening: (1) 60-day cancellation; (2) Employee Hired Autos under Symbol 8; (3) Broadened Named Insured for newly acquired/formed entities; (4) Employees as Insureds when using non-owned/non-hired autos in business; (5) $2,500 bail bonds, $500/day loss of earnings; (6) Amended Fellow Employee Exclusion (excess basis for owned/hired); (7) Expense of returning stolen auto; (8) Sign coverage up to $2,000; (9) Glass repair waiver of deductible; (10) Transportation expense $50/day to $1,500; (11) Hired Auto Physical Damage up to $50,000 per accident plus $1,000/day lessor loss of use up to 7 days; (12) A/V/Data Equipment up to $500; (13) Rental Reimbursement & Material Transfer Expense up to $3,000; (14) Airbag Coverage; (15) Auto Loan/Lease Gap; (16) Auto Lease Physical Damage; (17) Knowledge of accident requires notice to executive officer/insurance manager; (18) BLANKET WAIVER OF SUBROGATION preserved through insured contract/written agreement/permit prior to accident; (19) Unintentional failure to disclose; (20) Hired Auto Worldwide (30 days); (21) Mental anguish included in BI.

endorsements.name: Blanket Additional Insured - Primary and Non-Contributory
endorsements.notes: Blanket AI when required by written contract/agreement/permit executed before the accident and during policy period. AI limit is lesser of contract-specified or policy limit. Primary and non-contributory included. Exceptions: (1) sole negligence of AI; (2) negligence on non-owned/non-trailer auto by AI/Insured; (3) when AI is AI under another liability policy. Coverage to AI no broader than coverage provided to any other insured. KEY for Maricopa/Sacramento County compliance.

endorsements.name: Waiver of Transfer of Rights of Recovery Against Others to Us (Waiver of Subrogation)

endorsements.name: Loss Payable Clause
endorsements.notes: Standard ISO Loss Payable Clause for covered autos. Pays loss payee as interest may appear; subrogation rights preserved against third parties.

exclusions_of_note.name: Exclusion of Named Driver (Malina Trujillo)
exclusions_of_note.impact: No liability or physical damage coverage for any covered auto operated by Malina Trujillo (UM/UIM excepted). Operational/HR control issue — verify this individual is not driving company autos.

exclusions_of_note.name: Trade or Economic Sanctions Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard OFAC/sanctions exclusion. Low practical impact for domestic election services operations.

exclusions_of_note.name: Nuclear Energy Liability Exclusion (Broad Form)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Absolute exclusion of bodily injury or property damage arising from hazardous properties of nuclear material. Standard industry exclusion.

exclusions_of_note.name: Exclusion of Terrorism Involving Nuclear, Biological or Chemical Terrorism
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes only NBC terrorism: (1) dispersal/application of radioactive material or use of nuclear weapon/device; (2) release of radioactive material where terrorism intended such release; (3) dispersal/application of pathogenic or poisonous biological/chemical materials; (4) release of biological/chemical materials where terrorism intended such release. Does NOT exclude conventional terrorism. Run-Test serves voter populations and election infrastructure — conventional terrorism remains covered.

exclusions_of_note.name: Contractual Liability Exclusion (with insured contract carve-back)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Liability assumed under any contract excluded — but carve-back for 'insured contract' (§II.B.2.a) preserves coverage for tort liability assumed in qualifying contracts. Standard ISO language — supports contractual indemnity for Maricopa County and Sacramento County indemnity provisions.

exclusions_of_note.name: Pollution Exclusion (with auto-fluids carve-back)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes pollution from cargo or pollutants in transit. Carve-back preserves coverage for fuels/lubricants/exhaust gases needed for normal functioning of the auto, and for accidents away from owned/rented premises caused by upset/overturn of a covered auto.

exclusions_of_note.name: Care, Custody or Control Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes property damage to property in insured's care, custody or control or transported by insured. Carve-back for sidetrack agreement only. Cargo/property of others while in transit (e.g., customer ballots/equipment) is NOT covered under Auto Liability — must look to Inland Marine/Motor Truck Cargo for coverage.

exclusions_of_note.name: Handling of Property Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: No coverage for BI/PD before property is moved into the auto or after it is delivered out — handling-related claims fall outside Auto Liability.

exclusions_of_note.name: Movement of Property by Mechanical Device
exclusions_of_note.impact: BI/PD from movement of property by mechanical device (other than a hand truck) excluded unless the device is attached to the covered auto.

exclusions_of_note.name: Completed Operations Exclusion (Auto)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Auto Liability does NOT cover BI/PD arising out of your work after work has been completed or abandoned. Completed-operations exposure on services performed (e.g., ballot delivery) must look to GL/Products-Completed Ops, not Auto.

exclusions_of_note.name: Fellow Employee Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: BI to a fellow employee in the course of employment excluded — typical Workers' Comp/Employers' Liability backstop required. Note: 461-0155 Broadening Item 6 amends this to not apply to owned/hired autos on excess basis.

exclusions_of_note.name: Diminution in Value Exclusion (Physical Damage)
exclusions_of_note.impact: No coverage for diminished resale/market value following a covered loss to physical damage.

exclusions_of_note.name: Audio/Visual/Data Electronic Devices and Speed-Detection Equipment
exclusions_of_note.impact: Tapes/discs/portable audio-video gear and radar detectors not covered under Physical Damage. Carve-back for permanently installed sound equipment and equipment integral to vehicle operation. Note: 461-0155 Broadening Item 12 adds up to $500.

exclusions_of_note.name: UIM Exclusions
exclusions_of_note.impact: UIM does NOT apply to: (1) punitive/exemplary damages; (2) any claim settled without insurer's consent; (3) direct or indirect benefit of WC/disability insurer (except non-employee individual insureds); (4) anyone using a vehicle without reasonable belief they are entitled; (5) BI arising directly or indirectly out of war, warlike action, insurrection, rebellion, revolution, usurped power. Standard AZ UIM exclusions.
